Cleaned antimicrobial metadata for training set samples

Source: R/training_db_cleaned.R
training_db_cleaned.Rd

A standardized data frame containing curated metadata for training samples from the CAMDA 2025 challenge. Includes harmonized species names, phenotype labels, and genomic distance metrics suitable for modeling and exploratory analysis.

Usage

training_db_cleaned

Format

A data frame with N rows and 10 columns:

genus

Cleaned genus annotation

species

Cleaned species name

scientific_name_new

Standardized full species name after cleaning

accession

SRA accession identifier for each sample

genome

Genome identifier or flag for genome availability

phenotype

Interpretive resistance label: Susceptible, Resistant, or Intermediate

antibiotic

Name of antibiotic compound tested

measurement_value

Processed MIC or inhibition zone value

ani

Average Nucleotide Identity score to reference genomes

new_genus

Genus-level label used for taxonomic binning or modeling

Source

Cleaned and standardized from CAMDA 2025 training metadata
